title: 第121章 霍格沃茨第120章 风和日丽适合摸鱼
slug: 不是吧这魔修过于正义
content_zh:
倒也不是燕倾故意要听。
主要是他的修为太高，什么风吹草动都能第一时间捕捉到，所以自然就听了去。
“嘶！你们说这次宗主紧急召我们回宗到底是什么情况啊？”
“听说有不知死活的势力在攻打我们的山门？”
“你们啊，消息都太滞后了！根本就不是有势力在攻打山门，而是我们宗门惊现上古遗迹！”
原本燕倾还不感兴趣的。
可是听到这上古遗迹，他一下子就来了兴趣。
于是将神识悄咪咪探了过去，瞬间锁定了正在御剑赶路的三道身影。
那是两男一女三名年轻修士，皆穿着统一的宗门服饰。
领头的是个大腹便便的胖子修士，虽然体型圆润，但脚踩飞剑、御风而行的姿态倒是有模有样。
落后他半个身位的，是一个瘦高个男修和一个扎着双丫髻的女修。
女修听到这上古遗迹，明显眼睛一亮：“步师兄，你说的这上古遗迹是真的吗？”
此时，胖子修士正背着双手，站在飞剑上，摆出一副高深莫测的模样：“当然是真的！告诉你们吧，就在半日前，咱们宗门上空突然裂开了一道数万丈长的虚空大口子，紧接着，好几座庞大无比的上古遗迹，就这么跟下饺子似的，直接从天上砸下来了！”
“从天上砸下来？！”
那女修一听，顿时瞪大了水汪汪的眼睛：“我的天呐！那这上古遗迹得长什么样啊？是不是仙光缭绕、到处都是奇珍异宝呀？有没有传说中的仙器？！”
旁边的瘦高男修也激动得直搓手，两眼放光：“是啊是啊！步师兄，你师傅可是内门执事，你肯定知道内幕！快给咱们透个底呗，到底掉下来个什么宝贝？”
“咳咳。”
胖子清了清嗓子，接着说道：“我也是听说啊，宗主和几位长老亲自带人进去查探了。你们猜怎么着？那里面的东西，简直是闻所未闻，邪门得很！”
“到底怎么个邪门法？”
瘦高男修急得抓耳挠腮。

胖子压低了声音：“首先，他们那宗门的建筑就极其诡异！不是咱们这种飞檐斗拱的仙家气派，而是像一根根灰黑色的巨刺，直插云霄！更离谱的是，他们用五颜六色的琉璃拼成大窗户，上面画着的既不是仙禽瑞兽，也不是先贤大能，而是一些长着翅膀、不穿衣服的小胖娃，还有长着羊角、蝙蝠翅膀的异族邪魔！”
女修捂着嘴，惊呼道：“这……这画风也太阴间了吧？”
“还不止呢！”
胖子越说越来劲，唾沫星子横飞：“我师傅说，他们在遗迹里发现了那个邪宗的飞行法器。你们绝对猜不到那是什么！”
“难道是极品飞行楼船？”
“或者是什么罕见的大妖坐骑？”
“错！”
胖子一拍大腿：“是扫帚！”
“扫、扫帚？！”
两人异口同声，眼珠子都快瞪出来了。
“对！就是咱们杂役弟子用来扫茅房、扫落叶的那种秃毛木扫帚！”
胖子绘声绘色地比划着一个骑马的姿势：“听说那个邪宗的弟子，平日里不御剑，就光天化日之下，把那扫帚夹在两腿之间，在天上窜来窜去！你们想想那个画面，简直是有辱斯文，成何体统啊！”
女修脑补了一下那个画面，顿时小脸一红，满脸嫌弃地啐了一口：“哎呀！把扫帚夹在腿中间飞？这邪宗的作风也太猥琐、太下流了吧！毫无仙家风范！”
“就是就是，比起咱们御剑乘风的飘逸，这群人简直就是一群天上飞的扫地杂役！”
content_en:
It wasn't that Yan Qing wanted to hear it intentionally.
The main reason is that his cultivation level is too high and he can catch any disturbance immediately, so he naturally listens to it.
"Hiss! What do you think is going on when the sect leader urgently calls us back to the sect this time?"
"I heard that there are unscrupulous forces attacking our mountain gate?"
"You guys, the news is too late! It's not that there are forces attacking the mountain gate at all, but our sect's unexpected discovery of ancient ruins!"
Originally, Yan Qing was not interested.
But when he heard about this ancient ruins, he suddenly became interested.
So he quietly probed over with his spiritual consciousness, and instantly locked onto the three figures who were rushing on their way with their swords.
There were three young monks, two men and one woman, all wearing uniform sect costumes.
The leader is a fat monk with a big belly. Although he has a round body, he has a decent posture of walking with a flying sword on his feet and riding the wind.
Half a body behind him were a tall and thin male cultivator and a female cultivator with a double bun.
When the female cultivator heard about the ancient ruins, her eyes visibly lit up: "Brother Bu, are the ancient ruins you mentioned true?"
At this time, the fat monk was standing on the flying sword with his hands behind his back, showing an inscrutable look: "Of course it is true! Let me tell you, just half a day ago, a large hole in the void tens of thousands of feet long suddenly opened above our sect, and then, several huge ancient ruins fell directly from the sky like dumplings!"
"Smashed down from the sky?!"
When the female cultivator heard this, her watery eyes suddenly widened: "Oh my god! What does this ancient ruins look like? Is it surrounded by fairy lights and full of rare treasures? Are there any legendary fairy weapons?!"
The tall and thin male cultivator next to him also rubbed his hands in excitement, his eyes shining: "Yes, yes! Brother Bu, your master is the deacon of the inner sect, you must know the inside story! Come and tell us the truth, what kind of treasure fell down?"
"Ahem."
The fat man cleared his throat and continued: "I also heard that the sect leader and several elders personally led people in to investigate. Guess what? The things in there are simply unheard of and very evil!"
"What kind of evil method is this?"
The tall and lanky male cultivator scratched his head and head anxiously.
The fat man lowered his voice: "First of all, the architecture of their sect is extremely weird! It's not the fairy style like ours with cornices and brackets, but like giant gray-black thorns sticking into the sky! What's even more outrageous is that they use The large windows are made of colorful glass, and the paintings on them are neither fairy birds or beasts, nor sages and great men, but some fat little boys with wings and no clothes, and alien demons with goat horns and bat wings! "
The female cultivator covered her mouth and exclaimed: "This... the style of this painting is too underworld, isn't it?"
"That's not all!"
The fat man became more and more enthusiastic as he spoke, spitting everywhere: "My master said that they found the evil sect's flying magic weapon in the ruins. You will never guess what it is!"
"Is it the ultimate flying building ship?"
"Or some rare great demon mount?"
"Wrong!"
The fat man slapped his thigh: "It's a broom!"
"S-broom?!"
The two of them said in unison, their eyes almost popping out.
"Yes! It's the kind of bald wood broom that our handyman disciples use to sweep latrines and sweep fallen leaves!"
The fat man vividly demonstrated a riding posture: "I heard that the disciple of the evil sect, who does not wield a sword on weekdays, would put the broom between his legs and jump around in the sky in broad daylight! If you think about that scene, it is simply degrading and unbecoming!"
The female cultivator thought about the scene, then her face turned red and she spat with disgust: "Oh! Flying with the broom between your legs? This evil sect's style is too vulgar and obscene! It has no fairy style!"
"That's right, compared to our royal family,With their swords flying gracefully in the wind, these people were like a group of sweeping men flying in the sky! "
